body_markdown:
****


**New York, NY –**[Taboola](https://www.taboola.com/) (Nasdaq: TBLA),


a global leader in delivering performance at scale for advertisers,


today ann


ounced that it has been chosen as a finalist for ‘Excellence in Publisher Growth & Monetization’ with


The AdExchanger Awards.


This achievement is based on the success of Taboola’s generative AI technology for publishers called


[DeeperDive](https://www.taboola.com/deeperdive/) .


**What:** The AdExchanger Awards celebrate excellence in digital marketing and advertising.


**When:** The finalist announcement was released August 25. The winners announcement will be made at The AdExchanger Awards Gala taking place Monday, September 28th in New York during Programmatic I/O.


**Where:** The finalist announcement can be found on AdExchanger’s website


[here.](https://www.adexchanger.com/go/awards-2026/)
